title: The Sweet Summer
author: Rafael Kavanagh
blurb: Tamsin Joubert, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
